name: moodle-mcp
description: Read one Moodle site through its web-service API, limited to an allow-list of courses. It cannot start or see quiz attempts, submit, post, send, mark as read or record a view
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift that reads one Moodle site through the REST web-service API with a token kept in the login keychain.

Read-only by construction: the web-service functions are a fixed list in code, quiz attempts, submissions, uploads, forum posts, messages, mark-as-read, view logging and completion changes are refused before any request, and there is no generic call tool.

The site and account are set once with `moodle-mcp login`. Only the courses confirmed with `moodle-mcp selftest --discover` can be read; answers that mention other courses are filtered.

Messages: conversations are read through Moodle's own messaging. A site with messaging turned off answers MESSAGING_DISABLED, and there is nothing to read. Internal mail plugins (such as local_mail) are not read: their functions are not part of the mobile web service the token belongs to, so the token cannot reach them, and only the site's administrators could add them.

Every answer is bounded: a listing returns one page and says, before its data, how many there are and how to ask for the next page; a long text is clipped in a listing and read in full, a window at a time, by the id of its item. Requests to the site are paced, and a slow call returns what it has and says it is partial.

If the token expires, run `moodle-mcp login` in Terminal.

tools.name: moodle_status
tools.description: Read-only. Whether the stored token works, the Moodle release, the user id and name, and which needed functions the site does not grant.

tools.name: courses_list
tools.description: Read-only. The allowed courses, a page at a time, with id, full name and short name. Other courses are never shown.

tools.name: course_contents
tools.description: Read-only. One allowed course's sections and modules, a page of entries at a time: type, dates, your completion and files with token-free URLs. One module or section in full by its id. Records no view.

tools.name: file_download
tools.description: Saves one file of an allowed course to ~/Downloads/moodle-mcp/<course>/ and returns its path, size and SHA-256. Writes nothing to Moodle; never overwrites.

tools.name: assignments_list
tools.description: Read-only. Assignments, a page at a time, soonest due first: dates, maximum grade, introduction, your submission's status and your grade. One in full by its id. Never submits.

tools.name: quizzes_list
tools.description: Read-only. Quizzes, a page at a time, soonest closing first: dates, time limit, attempts allowed and your attempts' state and grade. Never questions or answers; cannot start or open an attempt.

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: Read-only. Calendar action events (deadlines) of the allowed courses, a page at a time, between from_date and to_date.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.description: Read-only. Your notifications attributable to an allowed course, a page at a time, newest first. Does not mark them read.

tools.name: forums_list
tools.description: Read-only. Forums of the allowed courses, a page at a time, with discussion and unread counts.

tools.name: forum_discussions
tools.description: Read-only. A forum's discussions, a page at a time, with author, dates, replies and the first message. Cannot post.

tools.name: discussion_posts
tools.description: Read-only. The posts of one discussion, a page at a time, as plain text with the HTML apart, and attachments. One post in full by its id. Does not mark read; cannot reply.

tools.name: conversations_list
tools.description: Read-only. Your message conversations, a page at a time, with members, last message and unread count; other courses' group conversations are never shown. Cannot send.

tools.name: conversation_get
tools.description: Read-only. Messages of one conversation, a page at a time, newest first. One message in full by its id. Does not mark them read; cannot send.

tools.name: grades_get
tools.description: Read-only. Your grade items in one allowed course, a page at a time: grade, range, percentage, weight and feedback.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Read-only. Your city and custom profile fields (such as the exam venue); nothing else from the profile.
